description: Literature review and related-paper discovery. Given a seed paper (arXiv id, DOI, or OpenAlex id) or a topic query, returns semantically similar and recommended scholarly papers to expand a reading list or systematic review, via Semantic Scholar recommendations with an OpenAlex related-works fallback. Keyless. [$0.03/call]. Params — id: paper arXiv id, DOI, or OpenAlex id; doi: alias for id (DOI form); q: query (alternative to id — relevance search); maxItems: 1-50 Example params: {'doi': '10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762', 'maxItems': 10}
name: related_papers
